run.peak_kind: conservative principal array payload envelope; not RSS; backend/FFT/allocator storage excluded
run.peak_rss_scope: Linux /proc/self/status VmHWM through output preparation, before final JSON serialization/write; null where unavailable; use external per-rank high-water measurements for the complete process

verification.note: delivered state is the converged step's own; a failed attempt continues SCF; work is also in the history entry's fixed_point_certificate
